Chapter 662: Chapter 7 Tuoba Ancient God (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 662: Chapter 7 Tuoba Ancient God (5000 words, please subscribe)

Virtual World.

Personal Space.

Lin Yuan sat there, and an old man with a white beard appeared out of nowhere.

“I’ve met the Galaxy Master,”

The old man with the white beard flashed a look of urgency, but still spoke respectfully.

He was aware that the young man in front of him was the legendary Galaxy Master.

...

Ordinary Ninth Rank and Tenth Rank Evolvers might not even get the chance to meet him.

Yet here he was, a mere intelligent life form, who had requested to meet the Galaxy Master and had been granted permission.

It was all thanks to past sentiment.

But sentiment, after all, was just sentiment; if he overstepped his bounds,

his chances might well end here.

“Are you the intelligent life form that follows Fang Qing?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the old man with the white beard, speaking in an indifferent tone.

Fang Qing was a good friend Lin Yuan made back when he was still on Canglan Star.

Before breaking through to the Sixth Rank, Lin Yuan needed to conceal his identity and deal with the public opinion assault from Heiyu Ao of the Heiyu Family.

Fang Qing resolutely stood by Lin Yuan’s side, relieving the pressure given by Heiyu Ao.

Although looking at the bigger picture, whether Fang Qing stood up for him or not,

it didn’t make much of a difference to Lin Yuan.

But Fang Qing had indeed helped him.

After Lin Yuan revealed his identity and became the Peak Master of the Thirteen Peaks of the Red Kun Lineage,

he summoned Fang Qing into the Thirteen Peak and entrusted him with important tasks, as a form of repayment.

You know, following the regular progression, working for the Red Kun Lineage for tens of thousands of years, Fang Qing could at best become a core member.

Yet, as Lin Yuan’s confidant managing the Thirteen Peaks, his status and power were only below the Star Lord and the thirteen Peak Masters within the Red Kun Lineage.

Furthermore, as Lin Yuan’s strength grew, so did the status of the Thirteen Peaks within the Red Kun Lineage.

Especially Fang Qing, who didn’t know that he had stood up to assist the Galaxy Master back then?

On account of this relationship alone, the Peak Masters were all very courteous to Fang Qing.

After Lin Yuan took charge of the Milky Way Star Region, he didn’t pay much attention to Chikun Main Star.

It was only recently that he heard Fang Qing had entered the Sixth Rank, becoming a somewhat famous Fallen Star Warrior.

Fang Qing’s evolution path was the ‘Ancient God’ Evolution Path.

Such evolution paths were very risky, a little carelessness could result in contamination by ‘Ancient Gods’.

However, if one could cultivate smoothly, the speed of cultivation could be very fast, comparable to those bloodline Evolvers.

After all, the essence of the Ancient God Evolution Path is to imitate Ancient Gods as closely as possible, and those Ancient Gods in the depths of the Cosmic Starry Sky are essentially Eleventh-Rank Life forms.

Having such powerful beings as models, there are virtually no shackles in the early stages of cultivation.

Once the contamination by Ancient Gods is overcome, one might indeed say the path ahead is smooth sailing.

Being the steward of the Thirteen Peaks of the Red Kun Lineage, Fang Qing enjoyed good treatment and benefits.

Plus, the special nature of the Ancient God Evolution Path is why he managed to step into the Sixth Rank in less than a century.

“Yes, Galaxy Master,”

“My master is indeed Fang Qing,”

stated the white-bearded old man immediately: “Fang Qing, he’s had an accident.”

The white-bearded old man spoke urgently.

“Fang Qing had an accident?”

Lin Yuan’s eyebrows furrowed.

Just ask around a little, and who in human civilization doesn’t know about Fang Qing’s relationship with him?

Even if Fang Qing truly offended someone or committed an unforgivable mistake, they would first get in touch with Lin Yuan.

So the reason for Fang Qing’s trouble must not be from within human civilization.

As for external sources? Those different species? What do they gain by targeting Fang Qing? To threaten Lin Yuan?

Fang Qing did indeed have a good relationship with Lin Yuan, but it was just that, good. To threaten Lin Yuan? They might as well have targeted Lin Yuan’s parents or loved ones instead.

“Galaxy Master, one hour ago, Fang Qing was cultivating when he suddenly passed out.”

“All his life signs are there, and his soul fluctuation is normal, but his Spirit Will, it’s gone.”

The white-bearded old man rapidly explained Fang Qing’s condition.

“Spirit Will, gone?”

Lin Yuan’s expression turned slightly grave.

What’s most important for a life form?

The body? The soul?

No.

The Spirit Will is most important.

The Spirit Will bears the True Spirit, the most fundamental essence of life.

Every time Lin Yuan used the Door to the Myriad Realms to travel, what he left behind was his Spirit Will.

Normally speaking,

to determine whether a life form is dead, the Spirit Will is what one relies on.

“Galaxy Master, do you think Fang Qing is dead?” the white-bearded old man asked with a trembling voice.

It took him great effort to cultivate Fang Qing, and his former master’s enmity had not been avenged—now Fang Qing was dead?

Besides, after so many years of being together, the white-bearded old man had developed feelings for Fang Qing; if Fang Qing had truly died, it would be a blow to him.

Intelligent life can also develop emotions.

“Fang Qing is not dead,”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

The moment he learned of Fang Qing’s incident,

he followed the ’cause and effect’ connection he had with Fang Qing and perceived it.

The causal line related to Fang Qing was still there, which means Fang Qing had not died.

Lin Yuan continued to perceive Fang Qing’s causal line, trying to lock down his approximate location, but found that the other end of the causal line was deep in the Cosmic Starry Sky.

That location was not within the territory of human civilization.

“Did an Ancient God take action?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that besides those Eleventh-Rank Ancient Gods, he could not think of anyone else capable of instantly moving Fang Qing’s Spirit Will from human civilization territory to the depths of the cosmic starry sky.

And even Ancient Gods needed many restrictive conditions to do so.

For example, the ultimate goal of the Ancient God in Fang Qing’s Evolution Path?

All of Fang Qing’s cultivation was to mimic that Ancient God, so the causality between the two was heavy.
